title: Incomplete identity intake
summary: Retain unknown or partial birth information without fabricating a patient birth date.

sections.title: Identity before testing
paragraphs: An incomplete intake record retains supplied evidence. It is not a patient identity or test order. Source documents remain a separate custody question; typed references and text do not retain their original bytes.

pages.title: Incomplete identity intake
pages.purpose: Record and reconcile intake when only unknown/partial birth date or supplied age is available.
pages.access: Order-entry capability and a signed-in person are required for capture/disposition; reads are audited.

fields.name: Include resolved and declined intake
fields.meaning: Whether terminal records appear alongside pending intake.
fields.rules: Changing the filter starts a new bounded list; Load more reads50additional records.

fields.name: Name as supplied
fields.meaning: Source name retained before patient registration.
fields.rules: Trimmed surrounding whitespace; not a patient match or a newly registered subject.

fields.name: Available birth information
fields.meaning: The kind of evidence actually available.
fields.values: Unknown, Partial date or Supplied age; no default.
fields.rules: Do not convert age to a date or complete a partial date.

fields.name: Exact supplied date or age text
fields.meaning: Source text retained without deriving a complete date.
fields.values: Required for Partial date/Supplied age; optional for Unknown; maximum200characters.
fields.rules: Surrounding whitespace trimmed. Not exact source-file custody.

fields.name: Source reference and reason intake is deferred
fields.meaning: Where evidence came from and why complete identity is unavailable.
fields.rules: Stored on the original immutable intake record; not copied into diagnostic logs.

fields.name: Original record and disposition details
fields.meaning: Original evidence/source/reason/actor/time and any terminal decision/source/reason/actor/time.
fields.rules: Resolution preserves original unknown/partial/age evidence. Issued artifacts and patient identity holds do not change.

fields.name: Choose verified patient
fields.meaning: Explicit selection of an existing patient after obtaining source-backed complete identity.
fields.values: Existing patient directory search with name/date/identifiers; no patient preselected.
fields.rules: Register verified patient opens normal matching/registration. Return and choose it explicitly; no link is inferred from the intake name.

fields.name: Verification or decline source and disposition reason
fields.meaning: Evidence for resolution to a verified patient or for declining intake.
fields.values: Both required, maximum1000characters each; blank initially.
fields.rules: Resolved must link an existing patient; declined has no patient link. Stale revisions are refused.

actions.name: Record incomplete intake / Retain incomplete intake
actions.does: Save supplied evidence as a separate immutable intake record.
actions.result: No patient, order or test is created. The item remains pending.

actions.name: Resolve with verified patient / Register verified patient
actions.does: Find a verified record or use the existing registration workflow after obtaining a full source-backed identity.
actions.result: Selection is reviewed in the identity banner; Record disposition is still required.

actions.name: Record declined intake / Record disposition
actions.does: Record an attributed terminal decline or resolution with source and reason.
actions.availableWhen: Pending intake at reviewed revision; resolution requires selected existing patient.
actions.result: Original source evidence remains. This does not create an order, merge patients or remove clinical holds.

actions.name: Refresh / Load more intake records
actions.does: Reconcile the list or load the next50records.
actions.availableWhen: Read authority; more rows for Load more.
actions.result: Refresh clears the selected record so current disposition must be reviewed again. Equal timestamps do not remove records from traversal.

actions.name: Close intake / Cancel
actions.does: Close the selected history or abandon unsaved dialog fields.
actions.result: No clinical data is removed. A pending intake remains pending.

actions.name: Open resolved patient
actions.does: Navigate to the explicitly linked patient.
actions.result: Review identity and holds before entering any order.

restrictions: No testing or order authority arises from incomplete intake. Never fabricate a full birth date.
Terminal disposition cannot be edited or reopened; the original intake is retained. Identity matching, duplicate resolution and source-document custody remain separate.
workflow: Retain supplied name, birth evidence, source and reason.
Obtain source-backed identity or an explicit decline decision.
For resolution, register/find the verified patient, compare the identity banner, and record the disposition with evidence.
Verify terminal history and use the linked patient workflow only when appropriate.

troubleshooting.problem: Disposition refused because the record changed
troubleshooting.recovery: Cancel and Refresh; reopen the record and review its terminal state before taking another action.

troubleshooting.problem: Patient cannot be found or identity remains incomplete
troubleshooting.recovery: Keep intake pending. Do not manufacture a birth date or register a duplicate to proceed.
Check Include resolved and declined intake, or record new incomplete intake when source evidence exists.
